ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.G.PANDIT) Learned counsel for the appellant has filed a memo seeking leave to retire from the case on behalf of the appellant.
Along with the memo, retirement notice dated 25.11.2025 and the returned speed post cover are enclosed.
The postal shara indicates that the addressee refused to receive the speed post cover.
2. Taking note of the above, we permit learned counsel Sri. Vijay Shetty B., to retire from the above case on behalf of the appellant.
3. The appellant has not made any alternate arrangement to represent him.
4. In the above circumstances, the appeal stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
Pending I.A's if any, stand disposed of.
